name: Scroll Expand
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; no React Bits source was read. A dependency-free scroll-linked clip or scale that replaces framer-motion with one custom property driven by an IntersectionObserver-gated scroll listener.

mode.description: clip opens a window over the content without rescaling it; scale grows the whole element.

from.description: Collapsed size as a fraction of the full box.

start.description: Viewport fraction of the element's top edge where expansion starts.

end.description: Viewport fraction of the element's top edge where the element is fully open.

a11y: No nodes are added, split or duplicated; the element's content, headings and links are read once, in DOM order.
The effect never intercepts, locks or hijacks scrolling; it only reads scroll position.
In clip mode the clipped margin is decorative and the text never rescales, so zoomed text keeps its size; keep essential copy away from the outer 11% of the box, which is clipped while collapsed.
Reduced motion removes the clip and scale entirely, shows the element fully open, and attaches no scroll listener.
